title: Looking after my teeth
examples: What should I eat to keep my teeth strong?
How often should I brush my teeth?

explain.say: Today we are learning about looking after your teeth.
First we talk about your milk teeth. These are the first set of teeth you have.
You usually have twenty milk teeth in your mouth. They help you chew your food nicely.
Next we learn about brushing your teeth. You should brush twice every day.
When you brush, you need a little bit of toothpaste. You should brush in small circles.
Finally we look at healthy food. Eating fruits and vegetables keeps your smile bright.

faq.q: How many milk teeth do children have?
faq.a: Children usually have twenty milk teeth in their mouth. These are the first teeth that grow in.
asks: How many baby teeth are there?
What is the number of milk teeth?

faq.q: How often should I brush my teeth?
faq.a: You should brush your teeth twice every day. Brushing in the morning and before bed is very important.
asks: When should I brush my teeth?
Do I brush my teeth once a day?

faq.q: What kind of food is best for my teeth?
faq.a: Eating lots of fruits and vegetables is very good for your teeth. They help keep your smile strong and healthy.

faq.q: Do I need to brush my teeth if I only eat soft food?
faq.a: Yes, you still need to brush your teeth every day. Brushing cleans away food bits and germs.
asks: Is brushing important even if I eat little?
Do I still brush if I eat soup?

faq.q: When do milk teeth fall out?
faq.a: Milk teeth will eventually fall out to make room for your permanent teeth. This is a normal part of growing up.
asks: Do I lose my milk teeth?
When do my baby teeth change?

facts: Milk teeth are the first set of teeth a person has.
Brushing twice daily helps keep teeth clean.
Fruits and vegetables provide nutrients for strong teeth.
Milk teeth eventually fall out to make way for adult teeth.

quiz.say: If you only brush once a day, you might miss cleaning which time?
quiz.why: You must brush at night to clean away germs that grow while you sleep.

wrong.0: This is tempting because it is also a time you should brush.
wrong.1: This is wrong because brushing must happen every day, not just after sugary snacks.
wrong.2: This is wrong because regular brushing is needed even when your teeth feel fine.

quiz.say: Which food group helps keep your smile strong?
quiz.why: Veggies are full of vitamins that help your teeth stay healthy.

wrong.0: Sweets have sugar that can make tooth decay happen.
wrong.1: Chips are often high in salt and can stick to teeth.
wrong.2: Water is good, but you need vitamins from food too.

quiz.say: If you have twenty milk teeth, what is the next step in care?
quiz.why: Brushing is the action you take every day to clean your teeth properly.

wrong.0: Waiting means you are not cleaning them, which lets germs build up.
wrong.1: You should brush regularly, not just when you feel pain.
wrong.3: Eating is what you do with your teeth, not the cleaning action itself.
